scope: local RV64 instruction-fetch PTE A-update AW/W/B lifecycle through OooFetchAxiBridge and AxiCrossbar

results.name: awaddr_uses_live_candidate_during_flush
results.purpose: Replace the frozen PTE AW address with the live candidate PC while the write channel is backpressured under mmu_flush_i.

results.expected_marker: flush+last AW records fire got=0 expected=1
results.name: awvalid_withdraws_on_flush
results.purpose: Withdraw a pending instruction-fetch PTE AW channel while mmu_flush_i is asserted.

results.expected_marker: repeated flush keeps BREADY got=0 expected=1
results.name: bready_withdraws_on_flush
results.purpose: Withdraw BREADY from the active instruction-fetch PTE write owner while mmu_flush_i is asserted.

results.expected_marker: both-done flush+B-error drains to IDLE got=0 expected=1
results.name: bresp_error_precedes_drop
results.purpose: Allow a B response error to override sticky or current-cycle semantic drop at instruction-fetch PTE write completion.

results.expected_marker: flush+AW+W+B completes to IDLE got=0 expected=1
results.name: completion_requires_old_done_bits
results.purpose: Require both registered channel-done bits before B completion, ignoring simultaneous AW and W handshakes.

results.expected_marker: flush+first AW records fire got=0 expected=1
results.name: flush_aw_fire_not_recorded
results.purpose: Discard an AW handshake that occurs in the same cycle as mmu_flush_i instead of recording the channel acceptance.

results.expected_marker: AW-first flush drains to IDLE got=0 expected=1
results.name: flush_drop_not_sticky
results.purpose: Fail to retain the semantic drop bit from mmu_flush_i until a later PTE write B completion.

results.expected_marker: flush keeps A-update write owner got=0 expected=1
results.name: flush_releases_write_owner
results.purpose: Treat frontend mmu_flush_i as transaction reset while the instruction-fetch PTE A-update write owner is active.

results.expected_marker: flush+first W records fire got=0 expected=1
results.name: flush_w_fire_not_recorded
results.purpose: Discard a W handshake that occurs in the same cycle as mmu_flush_i instead of recording the channel acceptance.

results.expected_marker: flush+last-AW+B completes to IDLE got=0 expected=1
results.name: last_aw_fire_not_counted
results.purpose: Ignore the current-cycle final AW handshake in the PTE write completion predicate.

results.expected_marker: flush+last-W+B completes to IDLE got=0 expected=1
results.name: last_w_fire_not_counted
results.purpose: Ignore the current-cycle final W handshake in the PTE write completion predicate.

results.expected_marker: flush+last-AW+B completes to IDLE got=0 expected=1
results.name: same_cycle_flush_not_effective_drop
results.purpose: Ignore current-cycle mmu_flush_i when AW/W/B complete in the same cycle, allowing an obsolete fetch transaction to re-walk.

results.name: wdata_uses_live_candidate_during_flush
results.purpose: Replace the frozen A-updated PTE data with the live candidate PC while W is backpressured under mmu_flush_i.

results.expected_marker: repeated flush keeps W valid got=0 expected=1
results.name: wvalid_withdraws_on_flush
results.purpose: Withdraw a pending instruction-fetch PTE W channel while mmu_flush_i is asserted.

results.expected_marker: split write slave awvalid got=0 expected=1
results.name: xbar_aw_capture_requires_same_cycle_wvalid
results.purpose: Require WVALID in the same cycle as an accepted AW channel, breaking legal AW-first master presentation.

results.expected_marker: xbar releases IFU write owner got=1 expected=0
results.name: xbar_b_fire_does_not_release_owner
results.purpose: Prevent the exact slave B handshake from releasing the AxiCrossbar write owner and its master-busy state.

results.expected_marker: split write owner remains active under B backpressure got=0 expected=1
results.name: xbar_releases_owner_on_bvalid
results.purpose: Release the AxiCrossbar write owner on slave BVALID without the master BREADY handshake.

results.expected_marker: w-first write slave awvalid got=0 expected=1
results.name: xbar_w_capture_requires_same_cycle_awvalid
results.purpose: Require AWVALID in the same cycle as an accepted W channel, breaking legal W-first master presentation.
